consent.title: Cookies and analytics
consent.body: We use cookies for anonymous usage statistics, error reports and session replays that help us fix problems. Nothing is collected until you accept.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains what PlayWithPro collects while you use the app, who processes it and how to change your choice.

collect.title: What we collect in your browser
collect.body: With your consent: the pages you open, the steps of a booking (catalog, coach page, checkout, session room, confirmation), errors that happen on the page, and a replay of some sessions. Your account id, role and language are attached; your email is attached only when you write to support.

vendor.title: Who processes it
vendor.body: PostHog Cloud (EU region, hosted in the European Union). The data is sent through our own domain and never to a third-party host directly from the page.

purpose.title: Why
purpose.body: To see where bookings fail, to find and fix errors quickly, to switch features on and off safely, and to answer your support requests with context.

replay.title: Session replay
replay.body: Only a share of consenting sessions is recorded. Everything you type is masked, as are dispute texts, your player profile description and the admin console. Links containing codes, tokens or signatures are stripped before anything leaves your browser.

server.title: What we count on our servers
server.body: Bookings, payments, refunds, disputes and cancellations are counted on our servers regardless of your cookie choice: these mirror records we already keep to run the service. They carry no free text and create no browser profile.

retention.title: How long
retention.body: Your consent choice is stored for twelve months and asked again when this text changes materially. Analytics data and error reports follow the vendor's retention for our plan; you can withdraw consent at any time below.

control.title: Your choice
control.body: Withdrawing consent stops capture immediately and clears the identifiers stored in your browser.
control.statusGranted: Analytics are on for this browser.
control.statusDenied: Analytics are off for this browser.
control.statusNone: You have not made a choice yet.
